title: The Dynific Addons for Elementor (formerly Anywhere Elementor) WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not perform a…
description: The Dynific Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin versions before 1.3.1 lack proper capability and nonce checks on an AJAX action that saves module configuration. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including those with Subscriber roles, to enable or disable plugin modules site-wide.
